facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2013-0079 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 26 February 2013 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2004-008 and INC-2025-010. The change request record covers 2 clauses across 4 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state abandoned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2026-0413, PRO-MEC-014 and PRO-OPS-032.
